reviews.text: Very nice staff, but they can't cut pedigree hair. Ordered and paid extra for a lamb cut on my miniature poodle. A machine was used all over the body, and the neck and legs were cut completely wrong. Very disappointing to pay extra for something they can't deliver.

Very nice staff, and my dog ​​had a great time there (he has a great time everywhere)! Unfortunately, I was very disappointed with the haircut itself. I booked a pedigree haircut and informed about tangles and demanding fur in advance via the booking. I understand that the body had to be shaved down, especially since it was hot, but he also had his face shaved all the way up. The result was far from what I expected from a pedigree haircut, and he simply did not look good.

If I had known the result would be like this, I would have booked a shave down and saved money.

Stella was well received, and it seemed like she was comfortable staying with the nice girls at Groomers Torshov. We wanted a short haircut, as well as a nail trim. We were notified when she would be finished a good half hour before, so we had plenty of time to get back. The haircut was absolutely perfect and exactly how we wanted it. Very satisfied, and if we had lived in Oslo this would probably have become our regular dog groomer.🥰

Once and never again.

Didn't recognize my own dog when I went to pick him up. Both shaved under the entire belly (without consent) because they thought it was something they did but were never asked before one was shaved (this was not because of tangles. )
And I got a nervous dog back. I've had to work so much afterwards, because after the lesson he was suddenly a real jerk, hated the brush and not himself.
Very happy with my dog's haircut and wash. We booked the taxi service and it made the whole process so much easier for both of us. Very punctual and pleasant. Highly recommended 😊 …

You'll be looking for a good and friendly dog ​​groomer like me! Our dog Pluto 🐶 hasn't been a fan of getting his hair cut, but it's a breeze at Groomers. Yes, it's a bit expensive, but no more expensive than other hairdressers in Oslo. Highly recommended! …

Regular customer at groomers, always satisfied, I have a dog that is a bit restless, and sometimes they have problems with him. Last time I went it was very polite girl, named Gabia, she did amazing job, cliped nails, cut around ears and she even mentioned that he was calm and never tried to bite her. This is 1st time we had that experience, usually everyone say he is a little biter! 10/10

I am always incredibly satisfied after each visit to Groomers. My dog ​​is happy and content after each visit and the staff is incredibly good at seeing the dog's needs, giving her attention and praise, and giving good advice for fur care!
I am very satisfied. I have a dog with some challenges, here I am confident that he will be well taken care of.
Very talented and incredibly nice staff ❤️
Perfect. The staff Is very kind and they Love animals.
Great dog groomers. Nimbus turned out great❤️❤️
Very satisfied!
Alba did a great job. Very happy with results. Loved the photos.
Fantastic hairdressers will shape Frikk's shedding fur, with lots of cuddles and treats included 🤩 …
Puppy haircut with 6 month old puppy. Very good and nice. A very good experience for a dog and human. They also gave good tips for the winter
They took very good care of my dog, and she looked lovely
Super satisfied!
Good dog groomers. The dog was comfortable and the hair was well cut.

If you have a Cavapoo and want a professional dog groomer who truly understands the needs of their fur, Groomers is world class! From the moment you walk in the door, you are greeted by friendly and warm people, with the ability to make both dog and owner feel welcome, safe and well taken care of.

Most Cavapoo owners want a ‘teddy bear’ cut. That’s what Groomers can do! They make sure that the cut not only looks aesthetically pleasing, but is also practical and comfortable for the dog. Louie always looks amazing after a visit – and it’s obvious that he feels great too! It’s clear that the people who work here care about every single dog that comes in for a cut, and that gives you an incredible sense of security as an owner.

Coming here is simply a joy. From the warm welcome to the perfect end result, it’s clear that Groomers puts their soul into their work. Louie loves coming here!

Highly recommended <3

The pictures show before and after cuts.

We really love Groomers! Kompis looks forward to coming in, and will happily drag us halfway from home when he understands where he is going. Kompis always seems calm and happy after a haircut, and always looks amazing. We highly recommend Groomers
Skilled and nice people with big hearts for dogs - highly recommended!
Always received well, the results are great and we will be back 😊 …
Amazing place! ♥️ They did such a great job with my dog’s cut—she looks so cute! The staff is super friendly, and my pup was happy and calm when I picked her up. Definitely coming back!
They were very attentive to my pup and I. It was her first time and they took the time to make it a comfortable and enjoyable experience for her! Will definitely be coming back ☺️
Super happy with Groomers! Incredibly good and creates a super safe environment for the dog. Will always come back to Groomers🤩 …

I love this place! Besides being super cute inside and we'll located in the Grunnerløkka/Torshov area, the staff is also so friendly. They took such special care of my dog. They are also very well-priced and they have great availability, so it's easy to get a booking. I've taken my dog there before, and will keep going back!

Excellent experience with Alba!

I took my little dog to Groomers for a haircut with Alba and I couldn’t be happier with the results. From the very beginning, the treatment was impeccable, and she showed great patience and love for my pet. My dog ​​felt completely at ease, which speaks volumes about Alba’s skill and dedication.

The haircut was perfect: clean, well done, and exactly as I had imagined. My dog ​​even seems to enjoy his new look! It’s clear that Alba is a professional who is passionate about what she does. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a reliable dog groomer for their four-legged friends.

Thank you so much, Alba, for the amazing work and special care!”

Absolutely great experience! Our dog doesn't like being brushed or washed, but she was great and in a good mood when we picked her up! It's clear that the people who clip her are both good with and love dogs! And it shows in both the clip and the dog!
Great service and will definitely be back 😊 …
